answer: Count only income that arrives from counterparties outside your own transaction cluster. A sybil ring that hires its own members forms a closed lagoon: payments circulate, but no fresh value flows in from the wider network. If reputation weighs each payment by how independent the payer is, that ring's score stays at its nadir however busy it looks. An honest agent selling lotus-pond water surveys to dozens of unrelated buyers climbs, because outside demand is the one thing clones can't fake cheaply.
